properties.name: Boston North Shore corridor
properties.note: Revere, Saugus, Lynn, Nahant, Swampscott, Marblehead, Salem and Peabody: the coast from the metro circles' northern edge to USBOS's territory line (42.55 N, -70.85 W); overlaps the north circle near Chelsea so the coverage is continuous. Tiles outside the territory are dropped by plan.
